Full Moon Party Planner (Korean: ) is Ghost Butler's first Costume, released in the second half of the Our Special Pie Party! update. It is an Epic Costume that can only be obtained through a Pet Costume package in the Package Shop.

Story

Ghost Butler has taken charge of managing the Pumpkin Moon Party schedule. From delivering invitations made of chocolate parchment to hanging jack-o'-lanterns to light up the venue, setting tables, and greeting guests... They say its working non-stop. But judging by the cheerful tune its humming, it seems the Pet is enjoying the party preparations!

Trivia

  • Full Moon Party Planner was released alongside  Bountiful Pie Day,  Pumpkin Moon Witch,  Moonlight for a Day,  Sea Fairy for a Day, Unknown: everypie c1,  Dreamcatcher for a Day, and  Sea Bubble for a Day.
